what_changed_since_v3.1.18_candidate: ZSS-BUG-033 (player-death hard-freeze + zeroed-results-stats report, owner-observed): found an already-deep, independent investigation from 2026-09-02/03 (docs/agent-runs/2026-09-02-p0-perf-freeze-rootcause/ROOT_CAUSE.md) had already root-caused and fixed the exact catastrophic-stall mechanism (a synchronous renderer.render() call inside the death presentation path), independently reviewed by both Codex and Grok, and confirmed that fix is still present and unreverted in this candidate's source. A fresh live retest directly refuted the 'zeroed stats' half of the original report on this build (real, correct, non-zero survived-time shown on the results screen) and did not reproduce the original catastrophic single-frame stall. NOT claimed fully fixed: no real-hardware Normal-Play death trace has been performed, and a separate, previously-identified, still-unattributed non-death combat-stall class remains untested.

ZSS-BUG-034 (pause/Escape non-interactive mid-game, owner-observed twice live): found three prior, already-deep investigations (docs/agent-runs/wn-pause-cx/) had all confirmed the escape-stack code is correct under every synthetic-input test, with the most recent specifically hypothesizing that automated (CDP) input cannot exercise the real native browser pointer-lock-release race a physical keypress can. Implemented that investigation's own explicit recommendation: bounded, guarded, purely-observational diagnostic instrumentation (no behavior change) so the real event ordering is captured automatically the next time this is manually encountered, rather than guessing at a fix blind.
known_residuals_disclosed: ZSS-BUG-033 (player-death hard-freeze): the specific catastrophic single-frame stall mechanism was already fixed in an earlier pass and remains unreverted; a fresh headless retest did not reproduce it and specifically refuted the zeroed-stats claim, but no real-hardware Normal-Play death trace has confirmed this is fully resolved, and a separate unattributed non-death combat-stall class (P0-2b) remains open.

ZSS-BUG-034 (pause/Escape non-interactive mid-game): still OPEN. Diagnostic instrumentation was added this pass so the next live occurrence leaves real evidence, but no fix has been attempted -- deliberately, per the standing evidence-honesty discipline against guessing a behavior change without a reproduction.
ZSS-BUG-029 MP5/M4A1 secondary-audio-layer contention remains OPEN, unchanged from v3.1.18 -- a fix attempt was reverted after an independent technical review found real correctness gaps.

Unchanged from v3.1.18's own disclosed list: WAVE 7+ ENCOUNTER, ZSS-BUG-020 (loot replenishment), ZSS-BUG-007 (compass/HUD alignment), and the same pre-existing test-harness staleness gaps (confirmed unchanged against a pre-session baseline, not new to this or the prior candidate).
Sawer's own canonical keep/revert decision remains explicitly unresolved by design; this publish does not decide it.
